lots.guide_summary: Only one close entry survives: a sold pair of hand-painted Victorian opaline vases at $60 hammer (Gowans, listed 2026-07-26), which is plainer than this pair. Category guides at Gowans, all sold, run $14 to $250 hammer (generic art glass pairs $40-$60, Czech tango vases $85-$100, a silver-rimmed pair $250). No unsold or asking evidence, and nothing found for a true Harrach or Moser applied-glass pair on the allowed sources. All AUD, no conversion.
lots.working: No same-item SOLD entry: the $60 pair is only close (painted opaline, no applied glass), so keep and flip are 0 by the rules. For context only, $60 / 1.198 = $50 would be the keep figure if that pair were treated as a match.
lots.confidence_reason: Single photo, no base or mark view, period and maker unconfirmed; price evidence is category level only.
lots.dropped_entries: None dropped; all ten Gowans entries were re-opened in the API and price, date and title match the researcher. Relabelled 424526 and 408442 from close to category guide because both are mixed lots with painted-only glass. Corrected the note on 391940: the photo shows a crimped basket, not a vase.
lots.key_photo_findings: Only one photo, front view of both vases. Applied glass work is real (raised green stems and leaves, applied glass prunts, crimped amethyst rims), with gilt leaf tracery and small enamel flowers and berry clusters, which is the Harrach and Moser applied-decor style rather than Venetian. Gilding looks reasonably bright. One prunt on the right vase looks darker or possibly missing; bases, rims from above and any pontil or marks are not shown, so chips, losses and period cannot be checked.
lots.condition: Unknown beyond one front photo; no obvious large damage, possible loss to one applied berry on the right vase.
lots.question_for_gowans: Can you check both vases for chips or cracks to the crimped rims and foot rims, any missing or reglued applied leaves or berries (especially on the right vase), wear to the gilding, and whether the bases have a ground pontil or any mark?

Flip: likely resale $50 from the only sold comparable, sold locally for pickup (Marketplace or Gumtree, $0 fee, $0 postage assumed); $50 / 2.396 = $20.87, round down to $20. With eBay (about 13% fees) and posting a 1.2m box (about $20), net would be about $23.50 / 2.396 = $9, so local sale only.
